dateRangePicker.flexHint:
How this works

1. Enter how many nights the trip lasts and pick a check-in month.
2. EVERY check-in date in that month is priced — the trip length stays fixed, only the date moves.
3. The price calendar shows the lowest price for each date; the cheapest ones are highlighted green.
4. Clicking a date fills it in as ordinary check-in/check-out dates and runs the normal search.

If you already know the month and don't need the scan, double-click it to open the exact-date calendar there directly.

What the price covers: the lowest accommodation total across all room types and meal plans at the selected hotels.
What it excludes: transfer and mandatory tax — both depend on choices made after a date is picked.
